description: This file defines the EffectiveVersion interface and its implementation, effectiveVersion, for managing component version information in Kubernetes, including methods for version validation, string representation, and range calculations.

classes.name: effectiveVersion
classes.description: Implementation of the EffectiveVersion and MutableEffectiveVersion interfaces, managing version details with thread-safe atomic operations.

methods.name: BinaryVersion
methods.description: Returns the binary version of the component, possibly the current default if useDefaultBuildBinaryVersion is true.

methods.name: EmulationVersion
methods.description: Returns the emulation version of the component.

methods.name: EqualTo
methods.description: Checks if two EffectiveVersion instances are equal based on their version components.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the version information.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the version ranges and consistency.

methods.name: AllowedEmulationVersionRange
methods.description: Returns the allowed range string for emulation version.

methods.name: AllowedMinCompatibilityVersionRange
methods.description: Returns the allowed range string for minimum compatibility version.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Returns detailed version info suitable for external use.

methods.name: SetEmulationVersion
methods.description: Sets the emulation version and adjusts the minimum compatibility version accordingly.

methods.name: NewEffectiveVersion
methods.description: Creates a new mutable effective version with specified parameters.

methods.name: NewEffectiveVersionFromString
methods.description: Creates a new mutable effective version from version strings.
